data.name: Haabeen
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-b-n', Haabeen means gentle, tender, and compassionate. In Islamic tradition, it is mentioned in a Hadith describing the character of Prophet Muhammad's wife, Aisha (RA), who was known for her gentle and compassionate nature.
